text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Puppet] or [TB] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Special Play Condition
text_sections.text: Assembly -2: Lv.4 or lower [Puppet]/[TB] trait card

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Puppet] or [TB] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
